recipes.name: Chipotle Spiced Black Bean Oatmeal
ingredients: 2 tsp chipotle peppers in adobo sauce
instructions: In a saucepan, combine the oats, milk, water, bouillon, chipotle, and Mexican seasoning*. Bring to a gentle boil. Cook for 10 minutes, stirring often.
Meanwhile, to a medium pan over high heat, add the corn and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned. Set aside.
When the oatmeal is cooked to your liking, add the black beans. When heated through, remove from the heat.
Divide the oatmeal between your bowls. Top with a generous portion of salsa, corn, and slices of avocado. Drizzle with fresh lime juice and desired garnishes. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes * The chipotle sauce is spicy, so add less chipotle if you'd prefer less heat.
Storage Store the oatmeal in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days. We recommend storing the salsa and avocado separately from the oatmeal and topping it just before eating.
